capabilities: Chat with a chosen LLM in a sidebar
Run a vault agent that searches, reads and edits notes
Preview AI edits as a diff before applying
Complete text inline at the cursor
Store custom prompts as Markdown notes
extras: The plugin interface is currently in Chinese; command names are documented in English. Inline completion and semantic search are off by default. Local (stdio) MCP servers are desktop only, and mobile is not fully tested. API keys are stored in Obsidian SecretStorage on Obsidian 1.11.4+.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to use an external language model for chatting about, searching, or editing notes inside the vault.

requires.name: Provider API key (not needed for local servers)

summary: Bring-your-own-LLM plugin with sidebar chat, a vault-aware agent, AI editing with diff preview, inline completion, custom prompts, local semantic search and MCP tools.
